text:
Eli: Heads up — Acme POC demo tomorrow morning. They just hit a spend alert even though they started on the trial credits. Getting intermittent 429s when exercising streaming paths. Can someone triage?

Devon: Which 429, rate-limit or quota? Any logs/snippets?

Eli: Customer sent this: 
> error: quota_exceeded code=429 detail=\"trial_credits_depleted\"
They also say portal shows ~12k credits remaining.

Anita: I pulled their billing row, shows credits_remaining = 0 in billing-service at 2026-02-27T22:13Z. Portal cached value might be stale. Looking at ingestion lag between auth and billing.

Sophia: tagging @sre-oncall for rate-limit headers — 429 could be x-rate-limit vs quota.

sre-oncall: I checked the proxy logs for acct acme-123 in the last hour. Some requests return: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 16
x-account-credits: 0
```
Looks like a burst consumed remaining tokens and the rate limiter is kicking in. That explains intermittent 429s.

Marcus: Are the spend alerts coming from billing-bot or our alerting policy? Could be two unrelated systems.

billing-bot: Spend alert triggered for customer acme-123: current_usage $1,204.32, alert_threshold $1,000. Triggered at 2026-02-27T22:12:03Z. Credits on file: 0.

Anita: Confirmed — billing-service marks credits 0. Portal cache shows 12,000 because customer was migrated yesterday and cache invalidation failed. Fixing migration hook now.

Devon: Two concurrent causes then: (1) credits actually exhausted in billing DB -> alerts, (2) burst of requests hit rate-limiter -> 429. Fix plan: refill trial credits for POC env ASAP, and temporarily raise rate-limit for acme-123 for the demo window.

Eli: Can we top-up credits manually? They'll need to continue tests.

Anita: I can insert a one-off credit grant: 
```
UPDATE billing.accounts SET credits_remaining = 12000 WHERE account_id = 'acme-123';
```
I'll run this once Marcus approves. Will also flush portal cache: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?key=acct:acme-123`

Marcus: Approved. Go ahead. Also mute spend alerts for 2 hours: `POST /alerts/mute?acct=acme-123&duration=2h`

Anita: Done — DB updated and cache invalidated. Portal now reports 12000 credits. Billing-bot should stop firing spend alerts.

sre-oncall: I temporarily bumped rate limit for acme-123 from 120 -> 600 for the next 3 hours to avoid demo blips. Will monitor.

Devon: After the DB fix I replayed a request with the customer's curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response now 200 with streaming. Headers show `x-account-credits: 11995`.

Eli: Great — can someone confirm client-facing explanation? They saw portal mismatch + 429s — we fixed cache + topped credits + throttled limit for demo.

Anita: I'll send a note to the customer: short explanation + what we did, and that we restored their trial credits for the demo. Also offering a follow-up with Sales/SE to recap quotas and expected usage patterns.

Sophia: Also logging follow-up action item for infra: add migration cache invalidation test and an alert if portal/billing delta > 1000 credits.

Devon: Filing an internal issue: INF-2026-311 — investigate migration hooks and ensure atomic update between billing and portal.

Eli: Thanks team — please keep me posted if anything re-appears. Looping in sales-ops to reconcile the account after the POC. :thumbsup:
